name: Google Search AI Mode
name_zh: Google 搜索 AI 模式
desc: A search tab that answers conversationally instead of listing links.
desc_zh: 用对话直接作答的搜索模式。
solves: A traditional results page gives you ten blue links and makes you do the comparing. AI Mode answers conversationally, plans a multi-step search, and hands back a synthesized answer with sources.
solves_zh: 传统结果页给你十条蓝色链接，比较的工作得你自己做。AI 模式用对话方式回答，会自己规划多步检索，并直接给出带信源的整合结论。
best_for: Comparisons and broad research questions where you would otherwise open ten tabs and compare them by hand.
best_for_zh: 对比类和宽泛的研究类问题——否则你得开十个标签页自己逐个比较。
notes: 集成在 Google Search 内的能力。来源：https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/google-search-ai-mode-update/
